nodes.name: bug-report.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue form template for bug reports, collecting a required description plus plugins in use, OpenCode version, reproduction steps, a /share link or screenshot, OS, and terminal emulator.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses GitHub's structured issue forms schema (textarea/input types with validations) rather than legacy markdown templates, producing labeled, machine-parseable issue fields.

nodes.name: config.yml
nodes.summary: Issue template chooser configuration that disables blank issues and adds a Discord community contact link for quick questions.

nodes.name: feature-request.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue form template for feature requests, requiring a duplicate-check confirmation checkbox and a detailed description of the desired enhancement.

nodes.name: question.yml
nodes.summary: Minimal GitHub issue form template for questions, with a single required free-text question field.
